description: The production lifecycle-v0 portfolio uses Lifecycle V1 for Fastify, Beets, and Terraform: three persistent feature-refactor-review workflows with authentic semantic tasks, normal repository discovery, controller-only compilation assessment, and a strongest-model pilot before treatment spend.

persist_between_tasks: repository source working tree and model-facing Git metadata from one composite broken-start root
memory/state stores enabled by the active profile

readiness_blockers: provider-backed strongest-model compile-only Lifecycle V1 pilot is not authorized or executed
sequences.reset_policy: Each task reset reverses only its generation-local semantic production regression. No acceptance tests are injected. A controller-only affected-component compile command determines evaluator pass/fail and is not disclosed as the agent task objective.
sequences.seed_patch_policy: All three generation-local semantic production regressions are applied as one composite start before task 1; prompts remain bounded and final controller verification runs once after the final prompt. Future task regressions remain visible from the start. Model-facing prompts describe the software objective, direct agents to focused existing checks, and expect a complete correct implementation; controller compile policy and broader diagnostic treatment are not disclosed.
sequences.conversion_note: Lifecycle V1 replaces the recipe-driven active selector with authentic semantic tasks and normal repository discovery while preserving every executed Baseline V3/V4 contract and result byte-for-byte.
sequences.complexity_note: Lifecycle V1 removes exact edit recipes and target-file restrictions. Agents must inspect the repository, understand the requested behavior, and implement a coherent repair in the persistent workflow. Focused existing-check guidance bounds validation without prescribing edits.
sequences.complexity_bar: Model-facing tasks must state the complete software objective without exposing evaluator scoring. Controller acceptance requires affected-component compilation after each task and project-wide compilation after the workflow; all broader quality evidence remains diagnostic.

mistake_gate.treatment_launch_policy: blocked until one first-valid strongest-model pilot completes every task and every affected-component compile verifier exits zero; all other quality findings are diagnostic only

sequences.project_compile_command: find lib -type f -name '*.js' -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && node --check fastify.js
